title: Message
source_topic: ICPC / The 2016 ACM - Asia Nha Trang Regional Contest
statement: Given a length n, a modulus M and a pattern string p of at most 50 lowercase letters, the task is to count the lowercase strings of length n that contain p somewhere as a substring, reported modulo M. The length reaches 10^12 and the modulus 10^12, so up to twenty such datasets must each be answered without enumeration.
